parameters.description:
Supabase's MCP server exposes projects, database schemas, edge functions and logs as tools, so an assistant can read the actual table definitions before proposing a migration, or check what a function is doing rather than guessing from its name.

Bring your own token: create a Supabase personal access token and store it as SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN. It reaches every organisation and project your account can, and these tools can read schema and data — prefer a token you can revoke independently, and treat read-only as the default posture.

Enrol and the tools appear in your client prefixed `supabase__`, reached through the one UnitySVC MCP endpoint you already configured.
parameters.summary: Inspect and query your Supabase projects from your AI client.
